sam.name: Sam
sam.notes: The «حوار» Sami, renamed for the English series. Impatient, hopeful, overconfident life-hacker who wants everything NOW. Big gestures, fast entrances, falls hard. Flaw: no patience. Heart: never gives up.

layla.name: Layla
layla.notes: The «حوار» Layla. Calm, dry, deadpan; small precise gestures; the straight man who is secretly fond of Sam. She smiles only once per episode (l25).
